title: MadaSymphonyMessage
description: Envelope for Mada Symphony spawn. Isolation fields drive spawn; they are not costume. protocol / message_type / sidechain / agent_id are refused.

movement.description: Current movement name, e.g., 'I. Overture', 'II. Variation', 'III. Counterpoint'

cue.description: Event or motive triggering this communication (e.g., SPEC_LOCKED, PATCH_READY, TEST_FAILED)

ground_bass_ref.description: Reference to immutable spec/contract, e.g., 'SPEC.md#v1.0' or commit hash

isolation.description: worktree = hermes chat -w (Subject/Horn writers). shared = Violin II / Snare on the sounding tree. delegate_task isolates context only.

allowed_toolsets.description: Heteronomous Tacet: spawn with -t matching this list. Empty = no tools. A Tacet chair must not receive file write or terminal.

tacet_paths.description: Ground-bass paths this chair must not write (SPEC.md, contracts, locked tests).
